answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 165894 Country: India Title: I would like to know if we can name our son Jibreel Mohammad? Question: We are having our second child any day now in-shaAllah. I would like to know if we can name our son Jibreel Mohammad? Thank you in advance. Answer ID: 165894 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 146/120/M=03/1440) Yes, you may give the name to your child. However, it is better to keep Mohammad first. Here are some other names you may choose if you want: Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Hassan, Salman, Safwan, Huzaifah, Mohammad Saeed, Rasheed, Hammad, Sajjad etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
